title: Micro-Collaborative Poisoning: A Distributed Attack on RAG Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.21573v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge sources, but this dependency also creates a surface for poisoning attacks. This paper introduces Micro-Collaborative Poisoning, a distributed attack in which a false target claim is divided across multiple locally plausible documents instead of being concentrated in a single malicious passage. We evaluate the attack across 108 RAG configurations by varying dataset, retriever architecture, retrieval depth, database composition, number of poisoned databases, and generator model. The results indicate that Micro-Collaborative Poisoning is not driven by a single dominant poisoned passage, but by the accumulation of weak adversarial signals across retrieved sources. Increasing top-$k$ and poisoning multiple databases make it more likely that these signals will appear together in the retrieved context, while clean database diversity

translated_title: 微协作投毒：一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的分布式攻击
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将大语言模型的输出建立在外部知识源之上来提升其表现，但这种依赖性同时也带来了可被投毒攻击的攻击面。本文提出了“微协作投毒”，这是一种分布式攻击：错误的目标论断并非集中于单个恶意段落，而是被分散到多个在局部看似合理的文档中。我们通过变化数据集、检索器架构、检索深度、数据库组成、被投毒数据库的数量以及生成器模型，在108种RAG配置上对该攻击进行了评估。结果表明，微协作投毒并非由单个占主导地位的被投毒段落所驱动，而是由跨检索来源累积的微弱对抗信号所驱动。增大top-$k$值以及对多个数据库同时投毒，会使这些信号更可能同时出现在检索到的上下文中，而干净数据库的多样性……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出针对RAG系统的分布式投毒攻击“微协作投毒”，将虚假论断分散到多个局部合理的文档中，证明该攻击的效力来自检索来源中微弱对抗信号的累积而非单一恶意段落。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Micro-Collaborative Poisoning, a distributed attack on RAG systems that splits a false claim across multiple locally plausible documents, showing that its effectiveness stems from the accumulation of weak adversarial signals across retrieved sources rather than a single dominant poisoned passage.
